regime_context: China A-shares thematic momentum is concentrated in resource themes: Gold Miners leads with very high durability (0.94), closely followed by Industrial Metals (margin 0.018). The absolute-trend gate has historically not reduced drawdown here, so trend-following leans carry heightened whipsaw risk. Track record is weak (hit rate 0.41, dir accuracy 0.32) and the cross-sectional rank-IC is insignificant, forcing low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch for the Industrial Metals rank to overtake Gold Miners for two consecutive weeks and the fraction of eligible themes to rise above 0.50. That would signal a confirmed broadening of the resource leadership from gold to industrial metals, retiring the watch.

The lean is conditional on the trend remaining intact and relative strength holding.
